about.title: Hello, I'm
about.name: Esther.
paragraphs: As a digital project manager and delivery partner, I'm the person you call when you have a digital ambition that needs to become real.

Moving quickly to understand your unique challenges comes naturally to me. Leading a strategic whiteboard session with your management team or running a technical review with your developers, both feel equally at home. My core strength is acting as the connective tissue across disciplines - bridging the gap between IT, creative, and business, and making sure complex work actually crosses the finish line.

Straightforward solutions and tangible action win over lengthy reports, every time. When we work together, you will always know where things stand - and you will always get a partner who takes ownership of the work.
